name: 922 FormingFinder
description: Discovers formed plate PDFs in a 922 batch via filename, PO NOTES, and PDF spatial analysis. Copies and merges them, then populates the Bent Plates sheet in the Pallet & Rod Organizer.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '922 QTDR Production Packages' folder and know the batch number.
The batch's order folders and the Pallet & Rod Organizer need to be in place (run 922 Setup first).
how_it_works: The app discovers formed-plate PDFs three ways: by filename, by the PO NOTES, and by analyzing the PDF layout.
It copies and merges the formed-plate PDFs and fills in the Bent Plates sheet of the Pallet & Rod Organizer.
output: Merged formed-plate PDFs and a populated Bent Plates sheet in the Pallet & Rod Organizer (which Kitting then reads).
